methodology.flare_source: authoritative list (NCEI GOES-R XRS science flare summaries, deduplicated across satellites) + SWPC 7-day after its coverage end
methodology.hit: first >=M1.0 flare within 24h of alert onset
methodology.false_alert: no >=M1.0 flare within 24h of alert onset
methodology.coverage: flare onset falls within an active alert window (primary metric)
methodology.advance_notice: flare covered at onset OR an alert started within the 24h before onset — delivery/awareness view using the same 24h window as the hit rule. NOT comparable to the preprint's 1:1 hazard-window coverage (64-71%).
methodology.miss_mechanisms: non-covered flares classified: expired_early (alert started <=24h before onset but window closed before it), late_alert (alert started <=6h after onset), blind (neither).
methodology.note: v2 (2026-07-07): replaced greedy 1:1 matching with the documented at-onset rule. v3 (2026-09-06): added advance-notice rate and miss-mechanism breakdown after live operations showed at-onset coverage declining in the isolated-flare regime of the falling solar cycle while advance warnings remained stable — the two metrics separate warning skill from alert-window timing. Historical verified.jsonl records preserved unchanged in all versions.
